$360,000 FOR AVIATION’S FUTURE. ✈️💛

A gathering of pilots can do more than fill a ramp—it can help someone else take the next step in aviation.

At the TBM Owners and Pilots Association’s 2026 convention in Phoenix, live and online bidding raised $360,000 for the TBMOPA Foundation. The foundation supports aviation scholarships, safety seminars and educational videos.

The three-day gathering also celebrated the first class completing the TBM Advanced Aviator Program, a voluntary initiative encouraging annual training and proficiency.

That’s a combination worth cheering: experienced aviators investing in their own skills while helping create opportunities for others.

The fundraising total is money raised for the foundation’s work, not a claim that $360,000 in new scholarships has already been awarded.

Here’s to a general aviation community that keeps learning—and keeps opening doors. 💛

Sources: Daher/TBM, November 3, 2026; General Aviation News, November 8, 2026.
